charge-rate-set.description: Requested charge rate. Positive = charge at this rate; `0` = do not charge. Honored when conditions allow (hardware limits, SOC constraints).

discharge-rate-set.description: Requested discharge rate. Positive = discharge at this rate; `0` = do not discharge. Same conditional-honoring semantics.

max-soc-set.description: Upper SOC limit (0-100); the device stops charging at this value.

min-soc-set.description: Lower SOC limit (0-100); the device stops discharging at this value.

backup-reserve.description: Off-grid energy reserve (0-100): the SOC floor held back for backup. A backup-mode policy; see the interaction note below.

dispatch-watchdog-timeout.description: How long a watchdog-class setpoint persists before reverting to `dispatch-safe-default`. Published so controllers know the refresh cadence to keep dispatch active.

dispatch-safe-default.description: What the device reverts to after a watchdog-class setpoint expires: `IDLE` (both rates effectively `0`), `VENDOR_DEFAULT` (vendor-internal logic resumes), `LAST_VALUE` (rare; slow-response systems only).

dispatch-state.description: Current dispatch status: `IDLE`, `CHARGING_DISPATCHED`, `DISCHARGING_DISPATCHED`, `VENDOR_CONTROLLED` (no external setpoint, or one expired to `VENDOR_DEFAULT`), `UNKNOWN`.

dispatch-controller.description: Identifier of the most recent client to successfully write a settable in this capability (MQTT client ID, issuing device ID, or authenticated user). Empty / absent when no dispatch is active.

charge-rate-actual.description: Observed instantaneous charge rate. Distinguishes "honoring the setpoint" from "hardware-limited to a different rate".
